class.jaymoskingdoms.option.fire.desc: Three bolts of fire in a fan.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.arcane.desc: A lance of light at what you're looking at, twice as hard on the undead.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.warding.desc: Absorption for you and the players beside you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.water.desc: Douses, slows, and hurts what fears water. Hold J looking at water (a cauldron, the rain) to absorb it into your reserve; hold J empty-handed for three seconds (or double tap and hold) to throw it as a barrage of water blasts.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.earth.desc: Staggers and knocks down. Hold J looking at natural stone, dirt or sand to absorb it into your reserve; hold J empty-handed for three seconds (or double tap and hold) to throw it as a barrage of earth blasts.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.air.desc: Launches what it hits. Hold J looking up into the open sky (richer the higher you are) or at a breeze to absorb it into your reserve; hold J empty-handed for three seconds (or double tap and hold) to throw it as a barrage of air blasts.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.lightning.de: Chains to whoever stands near. Hold J looking at a storm's sky, a lightning rod or a redstone block to absorb it into your reserve; hold J empty-handed for three seconds (or double tap and hold) to throw it as a barrage of lightning blasts.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.ice.desc: Freezes what it hits for a moment. Hold J looking at ice, snow or the frozen to absorb the cold into your reserve (it thaws them); hold J empty-handed for three seconds (or double tap and hold) to throw it as a barrage of ice blasts.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.draining.des: Life drawn from what you're looking at, into you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.raising.desc: A zombie and a skeleton climb out of the ground to fight for you a while.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.mending.desc: Heals who you look at, or you, and closes a cut. Burns the undead.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.sanctuary.de: A circle of light on the ground: friends in it heal, and the undead are thrown out of it.
Heal instead of imbuing. J mends who you look at; sneak and J is a ring of healing round you, or brings a downed friend back up. Your blows on foes heal your friends a little. Poison and withering hurt you half as much. Hold J looking at flowers, leaves, crops or amethyst to absorb their life into your reserve; hold J empty-handed for three seconds (or double tap and hold) to throw it as healing light that mends the living and sears only monsters.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.death.desc: Forbidden. Your blade's blows blight: no healing reaches them till it wears off. Sneak and J reaps the downed (your mana back), throws a death bolt at the living, or raises a body lying near as your thrall. Every death near you sends its soul to your reserve, and holding J looking at the undead, the dying, bodies or soul sand draws more; hold J empty-handed for three seconds (or double tap and hold) to throw it as death blasts. Withering hurts you half as much. Casting it corrupts you, and it's a crime where a realm's people see.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.blood.desc: Forbidden. Paid in blood, not mana: what you drink from the bleeding near you, then your own health. Your blade's blows cut. Hold J looking at a blood source (a stain, a bleeding foe, a blood grate) to gather it into your reservoir; hold J empty-handed looking anywhere else and it's thrown as a barrage of blood blasts while it lasts. Sneak and J grips a bleeding foe and drags them to you, throws a bolt that cuts, or (at nothing) bursts every cut round you. Bleeding hurts you half as much. Casting it corrupts you, and it's a crime where a realm's people see.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.blight.desc: Who you look at withers, and nothing heals them till it wears off. Healing magic lifts it.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.whispers.des: A body you look at tells you how it died, and how long ago.
For five minutes, the next time you fall you get straight back up. You're a little less alive until you next sleep.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.hemorrhage.d: Every cut on everything bleeding round you bursts at once. Paid in blood.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.blood_grip.d: Who you look at is dragged to you: a monster drops its weapon, a player is weakened. Paid in blood.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.frenzy.desc: Cut yourself for strength a while, and every blow you land heals you a little. Paid in blood.
